# Candidate Assessment: Mandatory Requirements

**Mandatory match: 7 of 10 (70%)**

| # | Requirement | Met? |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | Python | ✅ Yes |
| 2 | SQL | ✅ Yes |
| 3 | Linux administration | ✅ Yes |
| 4 | Git | ✅ Yes |
| 5 | REST API design | ✅ Yes |
| 6 | Unit testing | ✅ Yes |
| 7 | CI pipelines | ✅ Yes |
| 8 | Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, Ansible, Helm | ❌ No (none listed) |
| 9 | Kafka | ❌ No |
| 10 | GraphQL | ❌ No |

*Note:* I counted item 8 as one requirement, following the posting's numbering. If each of its five tools counted separately, the match would be 7 of 14 (50%). The conclusion is the same either way.

---

## ⚠️ Warning: Below the 78% Cutoff

At **70%**, the candidate falls short of your **78% cutoff**. The gaps are in containerization and infrastructure-as-code (item 8), event streaming (Kafka), and GraphQL. The candidate has none of these.

As you instructed, I have **not evaluated the nice-to-have requirements**.
